slots.name: LA Theater Works
slots.shortDescription: LATW's mission is to record and preserve great performances of important stage plays, using new technology to make world-class theatre accessible to the widest possible audience, and to expand the use of theatre as a teaching tool.

slots.name: Soundwaves
slots.shortDescription: Soundwaves Radio is a weekly open-format radio program that features established and burgeoning artists, creative personalities, and DJ's from all over the globe.

slots.name: Stairway To Heaven
slots.shortDescription: A soulful excursion through music and the stories they tell. Teddy Angelo Robinson rewinds your listening mind with classic soul from the artists/creators of the Philly Sound, Motown, Stax / Volt record labels and more. The music spans the late 1950s rhythm & blues to classic 1970s Soul, weaving real life stories in love, relationships, and good ole down home grooving.

slots.name: Eco-Justice Radio
slots.shortDescription: EcoJustice Radio presents environmental and climate stories from a social justice frame, featuring voices not necessarily heard on mainstream media. Our purpose is to amplify community voices, broaden the reach of grassroots-based movements, and inspire action. We aim to educate on and provide solutions for social and environmental justice and climate issues that challenge human health and wild landscapes across the USA, and around the world.

slots.name: Working Voices
slots.shortDescription: A program for and from working people in So Cal and around the world

slots.name: QR Code
slots.shortDescription: From the creators of the nationally-syndicated show Civic Cipher, we are proud to introduce The QR Code! Debuting on KPFK 90.7 FM in Los Angeles, The QR Code is hosted by Q Ward and Ramses Ja. The acronym C.O.D.E. stands for Culture, Opinions, Dialogue, and Entertainment—the four pillars around which the show is built. The hosts hold insightful and engaging conversations on topics that are widely discussed in popular culture, social media, and traditional media outlets alike. Expect political discussions, world news, sports stories, and conversations on the social evolution of America. Special guests/experts infuse the program with a degree of variety and provide additional perspective.

slots.name: Law and Disorder
slots.shortDescription: What happens when a movement gets a microphone? You get Law & Disorder—a fearless new show on KPFK hosted by longtime organizer, artist, and abolitionist Cat Brooks. This is not your average talk show. Law & Disorder exposes systemic injustice, uplifts movement voices, and agitates for real change. With sharp interviews, cultural insight, and a commitment to truth, this show brings the fire every week.

slots.name: This Way Out
slots.shortDescription: The only internationally distributed weekly LGBTQ radio program, currently airing on some 200 local community radio stations around the world. The award-winning half-hour magazine-style program features a summary of some of the major news events in or affecting the queer community (NewsWrap), in-depth coverage of major events, interviews with key queer figures, plus music, literature, entertainment — all the information and culture of a community on the move!

slots.name: Radio Maiz
slots.shortDescription: adio Maíz is a food justice radio show dedicated to protecting people's right to healthy food and their right to food sovereignty. We uplift traditional and Indigenous food systems through the voices of communities, farmers, seed keepers, food experts, and food justice advocates, centering maize as an ancestral staple of the Americas.

slots.name: Hablando de Sudamerica
slots.shortDescription: Un programa objetivo, destinado a la audiencia latinoamericana y en especial a la suramericana. Tiene el propósito de informar y llevar los acontecimientos más actualizados de America del Sur en cuanto a su política económica y social. El objetivo principal es acortar la distancia y romper el cerco mediático corporativo al que esta sujeto Latinoamérica en la actualidad.

slots.name: Perspectiva de Las Americas
slots.shortDescription: Perspectiva de Las Américas is a dynamic, 60-minute weekly radio magazine broadcast Monday nights on KPFK 90.7 FM that explores the rich landscape of Latin American politics, art, and grassroots activism. Blending sharp geopolitical analysis with compelling audio biographies of influential visionaries, the program connects major international currents directly to the struggles and triumphs of Southern California’s immigrant communities. From hyper-local community updates in neighborhoods like Boyle Heights to socially conscious music selections, this Spanish-language broadcast serves as an essential analytical and cultural bridge for the Americas.

slots.name: Voces de Libertad
slots.shortDescription: Voces de Libertad on KPFK 90.7 FM is a striking public affairs program hosted by Rodrigo Argueta that explores the complexities of grassroots resistance. The podcast provides a dedicated platform focusing on the deep-rooted political and revolutionary struggles within Mexico. Listeners can tune in to gain critical insights into community organizing, social justice movements, and the systemic fight for liberation. This program cuts through mainstream narratives to deliver authentic voices directly from the frontlines of activism.

slots.name: Insurgencia Feminina
slots.shortDescription: Radio Insurgencia Femenina es un programa de radio para mujeres que se transmite cada 15 dias. Nos enfocamos en noticias no corporativas, activismo, temas que afectan el bienestar social y emocional de las mujeres latinas, chicanas e indígenas. También traemos arte y cultura a nuestro programa para elevar el talento y dar voz a cientos de mujeres increíbles en todo nuestro continente.

slots.name: Suplemento Comunitario

El espacio está dedicado principalmente al análisis político, la difusión de las luchas de las organizaciones sociales y la provisión de información de alta relevancia para las comunidades migrantes.
